name: Empyreal Dawn
source:
[i]"Tragedies are eventually forgotten; betrayals are rarely forgiven."[/i]
-Edyssian Proverb

In the war-torn land of Edyssa, two opposing kingdoms—Crescent and Bastion—devastate the continent with their conflict.

With the kingdoms' armies diverted toward the war, a new class of heroes, Adventurers, arise to protect the populace from monsters and crime.

You are Albert Cross, Bladeseer of the neutral party Caeruleum. Accompanying you is Alice Starwell, a prodigious Swordsmaiden.

As Caeruleum's leader, raise your party to dizzying heights and etch your name into the annals of Edyssian history!

[From the [url=https://www.blissfulberyl.com/empyrealdawn]official website[/url]]
